Status: ACCEPTED\_SCOPE\_LIMITED — CURRENT AUTHORITY FOR D06-B / FC-04 MULTI-SELECTION ELIGIBLE-SUBSET PROPERTY EDITING.

## 1. Acceptance event and scope

On 2026-10-28, the user explicitly directed completion of the narrow P23 decision closure for D06-B, relying on the already stated product choice and the exact candidate text below. This record accepts only D06-B. It does not accept all proposed details in FC-00X-C, does not supersede other D06 decisions, does not close D07's separate overall OOM/release blocker, and does not itself authorize product implementation.

Accepted candidate: <mention url="https://app.notion.com/p/4064c57a590c81df8c47ca0969d09888" />

Decision request: <mention url="https://app.notion.com/p/4064c57a590c81eba7acdbcbbd354ef4" />

Parent design context: <mention url="https://app.notion.com/p/3f94c57a590c81b8ad8ceb2239759cba">FC-00X-C Capability Resolution Contract v0.1 — Capability Semantics Foundation</mention>, <mention url="https://app.notion.com/p/4064c57a590c81d9b562f037705e2345" />, and <mention url="https://app.notion.com/p/4064c57a590c81a997ddfff3da30ccea" />.

## 2. Accepted rule

For a property command over normalized selected operation roots S:

- Runtime resolves property applicability through the accepted feature/capability owner, not a UI-local object-kind switch.
- The projection reports eligible/total and typed reasons for semantically inapplicable roots before execution.
- Uniform/Mixed is computed over eligible roots E; Partial applicability is a separate dimension.
- A command may intentionally mutate E and leave U unchanged only when the subset policy is visible before execution and the result reports exact changed/skipped roots and typed reasons.
- The eligible cohort E is atomic: all eligible roots commit together or none do.
- A semantically inapplicable/unsupported root may be excluded under this explicit policy.
- A root that is applicable but locked, permission-denied, stale, missing, invalid, concurrently changed, or conflicting is not reclassified as inapplicable. Unless an already accepted command contract explicitly defines safe recovery, reject the entire command before canonical mutation.
- Unknown applicability/provider/query outcomes are Indeterminate/Unavailable, not Unsupported, and must not silently shrink E.
- Revalidate selection/document/semantic generation, target state, permission and payload at command admission.
- Per-target outcomes/reasons must be returned. A failed eligible-cohort batch produces no partial canonical mutation and no successful user-visible History entry.
- No new FieldId, PropertyValue, canonical Operation, global Transaction, wire semantics, public ABI, or registry is introduced by this decision.

## 3. Authority precedence and exclusions

This acceptance resolves only the D06-B eligible-subset policy previously marked OPEN by FC-00X-C. It does not:

- accept all remaining review-proposal details in FC-00X-C;
- claim the runtime read-provider/capability/write/History chain is implemented end-to-end;
- close MSE test obligations or declare them passed;
- change D07's separate multi-Operation one-Undo contract;
- authorize Group/Ungroup source changes by itself;
- grant merge/release readiness or override the known D07 OOM hang.

The accepted rule is prospective. Existing code remains implementation reality and must be audited against this rule. Missing providers are Indeterminate/Unavailable; do not infer full end-to-end support from the field registry or validator alone.

## 4. Required verification bindings

Carry MSE-01..MSE-27 forward. D06-B-specific blocking cases:

- MSE-07 and MSE-19: eligible/total and explicit excluded reasons.
- MSE-20: applicable but locked/stale/denied target rejects the eligible cohort with zero mutation.
- MSE-21: Mixed and Partial are independent dimensions.
- MSE-23: injected failure leaves Document, Scene publication, History cursor and Redo branch unchanged.
- MSE-26: missing provider yields Indeterminate/Unavailable and cannot enable the UI.
- MSE-27: stale projection is rejected or recomputed before commit.

The exact test IDs, source paths, commands, expected outputs and evidence artifact locations must be frozen by the successor Phase 2 P31 package before implementation.

## 5. Current state and supersession

Current D06-B status: ACCEPTED\_SCOPE\_LIMITED.

The previous OPEN wording in FC-00X-C remains in the historical body to preserve its original review state. This accepted record is the only Current authority increment for D06-B; downstream plans must link this record and stop treating D06-B as an unresolved authority question. Any further changes require a new versioned decision, not silent edits to this acceptance.

D07 functional scope has separately reached P34 PASS\_WITH\_FINDINGS at exact result revision 6bcf2d4bbf3314e5252951190c3c475403f52665; the overall D07/release remains blocked by the known Protobuf/Abseil descriptor-initialization OOM hang. No part of this D06-B decision waives that finding.

## 6. Next execution consequence

The next task is not another D06-B design review. Update the Phase 2 source/authority matrix and prepare a new, exact-source P31 package for the remaining Multi-selection Editing work. That package must include the D06-B authority above, the exact D07 functional evidence, the MSE-01..MSE-27 matrix, property read/applicability/capability/write/History bindings, FC-02 TextEdit/Escape wiring, required platform checks, and explicit exclusions. P32 may start only after the new package's required preflights pass.

This record is not a claim that Phase 2 implementation is complete, nor does it claim D07 overall release closure.
